i.norm: Total number of lines written to the test file ("LINE 0" … "LINE 8").
Lines whose last digit satisfies {@code (digit % 3) == 1} are filtered out by {@link #testFiltering}. For 9 lines (digits 0–8) those are lines 1, 4, and 7, leaving 6 valid lines.
